---
title: "System Network"
subtitle: "Connectivity between chromatographic systems"
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(rePredRet)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

# Statistics are computed from the published model index, so they are always current
index <- tryCatch(rePredRet_models(), error = function(e) NULL)
has_data <- !is.null(index) && nrow(index) > 0

systems <- tryCatch(rePredRet_systems(), error = function(e) NULL)
```

## Network Overview

The network shows how chromatographic systems are connected through pairwise models. Each node is a system and each edge a model between two systems (models are directional: one per source/target pair).

```{r network-summary}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) {
  n_nodes <- length(unique(c(index$sys1_id, index$sys2_id)))
  n_edges <- nrow(index)

  summary_table <- data.frame(
    Metric = c(
      "Total Systems (Nodes)",
      "Total Models (Edges)",
      "Average Models per System (as source)",
      "Network Density"
    ),
    Value = c(
      n_nodes,
      format(n_edges, big.mark = ","),
      round(n_edges / n_nodes, 1),
      sprintf("%.2f%%", n_edges / (n_nodes * (n_nodes - 1)) * 100)
    )
  )
  kable(summary_table, align = "lr")
} else {
  cat("The model index could not be loaded.")
}
```

## Network Visualization

```{r network-plot}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 12
#| echo: false
if (has_data) {
  rePredRet_plot_network(min_compounds = 20, show_labels = FALSE) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16))
}
```

## Connectivity Statistics

### Systems with Most Connections

```{r most-connected}
#| echo: false
if (has_data) {
  outgoing <- count(index, system_id = sys1_id, name = "n_outgoing")
  incoming <- count(index, system_id = sys2_id, name = "n_incoming")

  connections <- full_join(outgoing, incoming, by = "system_id") %>%
    mutate(
      n_outgoing = coalesce(n_outgoing, 0L),
      n_incoming = coalesce(n_incoming, 0L),
      total = n_outgoing + n_incoming
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(total)) %>%
    head(20)

  if (!is.null(systems)) {
    connections$name <- systems$name[match(connections$system_id, systems$id)]
    connections <- connections[, c("system_id", "name", "n_outgoing", "n_incoming", "total")]
    col_names <- c("System", "Name", "Outgoing", "Incoming", "Total")
  } else {
    col_names <- c("System", "Outgoing", "Incoming", "Total")
  }

  kable(connections, col.names = col_names, caption = "Top 20 most connected systems")
}
```

### Connection Distribution

```{r connection-histogram}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
#| echo: false
if (has_data) {
  all_connections <- bind_rows(
    count(index, system_id = sys1_id),
    count(index, system_id = sys2_id)
  ) %>%
    group_by(system_id) %>%
    summarize(total_connections = sum(n), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(all_connections, aes(x = total_connections)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = median(all_connections$total_connections),
               color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
      x = "Number of Connections (models as source or target)",
      y = "Number of Systems",
      title = "Distribution of System Connectivity"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14)
}
```

## Models by Compound Count

```{r models-by-compounds}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
#| echo: false
if (has_data) {
  ggplot(index, aes(x = n_compounds)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    labs(
      x = "Number of Common Compounds (log scale)",
      y = "Number of Models",
      title = "Distribution of Model Sizes"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14)
}
```

## Heatmap of System Pairs

```{r heatmap}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 12
#| echo: false
if (has_data) {
  # Order systems by connectivity so the densely connected core is grouped
  system_order <- names(sort(table(c(index$sys1_id, index$sys2_id)), decreasing = TRUE))

  ggplot(index, aes(x = factor(sys1_id, levels = system_order),
                    y = factor(sys2_id, levels = system_order),
                    fill = log10(n_compounds))) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
    labs(
      x = "Source System",
      y = "Target System",
      fill = "log10(N)",
      title = "Model Availability Heatmap",
      subtitle = "Systems ordered by number of models"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    coord_fixed()
}
```
